terms.definition: A controlled rollout to a limited population before broad availability.

positive_example.source: 本次灰度发布仅面向试点租户。
positive_example.target: This phased rollout is limited to pilot tenants.

negative_example.source: 图片灰度处理完成后再发布。
negative_example.reason: This is image grayscale processing, not release management.

terms.definition: An account or organizational boundary in a multi-tenant cloud service.

positive_example.source: 只有试点租户可以启用该功能。
positive_example.target: Only pilot tenants can enable this feature.

negative_example.reason: This is a housing renter context, not a cloud account boundary.

terms.definition: A customer support case tracked by a service desk workflow.

positive_example.source: 客户提交工单后会收到确认邮件。
positive_example.target: After the customer submits a support ticket, they receive a confirmation email.

negative_example.reason: This may be a field-service work order rather than customer support.
